insights.title: See what influencers are looking for
insights.lead: We count what verified influencers search for and which briefs they open. You see the trends and shape your next brief around them.

points.money: Money or barter, and the budgets influencers look for

insights.privacy: Anonymous totals only. No one’s personal data.

analytics.title: Know who you’re working with before you say yes
analytics.lead: Every applicant comes with numbers pulled straight from Instagram, TikTok or YouTube. No screenshots, no guessing.

points.official: Followers, views and engagement from the platform’s official API
points.audience: Who the audience is: age, gender and countries

toolkit.title: Everything for collabs, right in your pocket
toolkit.lead: Briefs that fit you, offers companies can book, your own public page, and notifications that find you wherever you are.

push.body: New briefs, replies from companies and requests for your offers land on your phone the moment they happen.

email.subject: 3 new briefs for you today
email.r1: Reels about our new coffee bar
email.r2: A weekend in the Alps, filmed for Reels

match.title: A match score on every brief

track.title: Track every application
track.body: Applied, viewed, shortlisted, accepted: you always know where you stand.
